metadata.question: Was there a noticeable larger bloom (represented by a brighter blue color) in Hood Canal in late August 2022, compared to August 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use Sentinel-2 MSI because its 10 m “blue” band (B2) resolves algal blooms in narrow fjords like Hood Canal. - Date windows: For each year pick “late August” → 20–31 Aug (12 d). - Location: Hood Canal, WA. A small offshore rectangle inside the canal (≈10 km²) minimises land/cloud pixels. 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud & cirrus via the Sentinel-2 QA60 band (bits 10 & 11). - Water mask with JRC Yearly Water 2021 (keeps only perennial water); this throws out land glint that can bias “bright blue”. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/error: - Check collection size after date/cloud/water filters. 0 → C1. - After compositing (median) check pixel count. 0 → C2. - Extract mean TOA reflectance in B2 (blue). A result of None/NaN → C3. - “Noticeably larger bloom” → if 2022 mean blue reflectance is > 2021 mean we answer A, else B. (Brighter blue = higher reflectance.) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time hood = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-123.05, 47.33, -122.85, 47.43]) # Hood Canal centre aug21 = ('2021-08-20', '2021-08-31') aug22 = ('2022-08-20', '2022-08-31') s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') water = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/YearlyHistory/2021').eq(2) # perennial water def get_blue(year): col = (s2 .filterBounds(hood) .filterDate(*year) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask( img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0) # cloud/cirrus .And(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<11).eq(0)) .And(water)) .select(['B2']))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: # C1 check print("Images 0") return None comp = col.median().rename('blue') cnt = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=hood, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('blue').getInfo() if cnt == 0: # C2 check print("Valid pixels 0") return None mean = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=hood, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('blue').getInfo() return mean b21 = get_blue(aug21) b22 = get_blue(aug22) if b21 is None or b22 is None: print("C1") else: print(f"2021 blue: {b21:.3f} 2022 blue: {b22:.3f}") if b22 > b21: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
hood = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-123.05, 47.33, -122.85, 47.43])  # Hood Canal centre
aug21 = ('2021-08-20', '2021-08-31')
aug22 = ('2022-08-20', '2022-08-31')
s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
water = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/YearlyHistory/2021').eq(2)  # perennial water

def get_blue(year):
    col = (s2
           .filterBounds(hood)
           .filterDate(*year)
           .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))
           .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(
                   img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0)  # cloud/cirrus
                      .And(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<11).eq(0))
                      .And(water))
               .select(['B2'])))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:  # C1 check
        print("Images 0")
        return None
    comp = col.median().rename('blue')
    cnt = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                            geometry=hood, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('blue').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0:  # C2 check
        print("Valid pixels 0")
        return None
    mean = comp.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                             geometry=hood, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('blue').getInfo()
    return mean

b21 = get_blue(aug21)
b22 = get_blue(aug22)
if b21 is None or b22 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2021 blue: {b21:.3f}  2022 blue: {b22:.3f}")
    if b22 > b21:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
